Research

Autonomous Targeting Satellite for Cloud Observation

My PhD project! A simulation for a satellite that autonomously targets clouds.

X
  • Conceptual satellite system that, after receiving context of upcoming cloud locations, autonomously plans slew maneuvers to optimize observation.
  • Simulation environment to explore different algorithms, lookahead sizes, instruments, and more!
  • Off nadir lidar characterization and performance evaluation.
  • Systems analysis and optimization for satellite architecture options.
  • Skills: Programming, autonomous systems, satellite modeling (power, controls, storage), genetic algorithm optimization, orbital mechanics.
  • Tools: Python (NumPy, pygame, Gymnasium, pymoo, SkyField)
SPECIES

A deployable lidar system for small satellites.

X
  • A NASA Earth Science Technology Office project to explore how a deployable diffractive optical element could be used on small satellites as a lidar receiver.
  • I was responsible for developing a lidar characterization simulation environment to evaluate the performance of our theoretical system against existing orbital lidars.
  • Used CALIOP data from the CALIPSO satellite to observe differences in SNR.
  • Skills: Lidar modeling, remote sensing data analysis.
  • Tools: MATLAB, NASA EarthData
Remote Sensing for Energy Infrastructure Monitoring

Preventing wildfires by detecting and monitoring faults on power lines.

X
  • A study under the MIT Energy Initiative on how orbital assets could be used to monitor energy infrastructure.
  • Compiled statistics on power line faults and their relation to wildfire incidents.
  • Developed a random forest model to predict wildfire risk based on vegetation, weather, geography, and power line emissions.
  • Skills: Machine learning, data analysis, remote sensing.
  • Tools: Python (scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy), Google Earth Engine
SEASALT

A CubeSat for monitoring ocean salinity and sea surface temperature.

Accomplishments
  • Project manager for a collaboration between MIT, Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, and the Naval Research Laboratory.
  • Lead the team through two design reviews, MDR and sPDR, ensuring all requirements were met.
  • Worked on characterizing algorithm performance as well as leading structural design.
  • Skills: Project management, systems engineering, remote sensing data management, 3D modeling, structural analysis.
  • Tools: Python, Solidworks
Orbital Locker: Modular CubeSat Assembly

A robotic CubeSat assembly system for orbital deployment.

Accomplishments
  • Designed 3D printable snap-fit structures to hold and electronically mate CubeSat boards.
  • Programmed safe and consistent robotic assembly procedures.
  • Managed a team of MIT students at both the graduate and undergraduate level to meet milestones.
  • Skills: Robotics, 3D modeling, structural design, project management
  • Tools: Python, Solidworks, FDM 3D printers, electronics hardware, Raspberry Pi, Arduino
And more!
